README.md:
# sales — data product (dbt project)

Generated by the Sovereign Agentic OS from the domain's dataset definitions. The OS is the
writer: every dataset, composition, quality rule, sync or publish change in the UI or through the
OS MCP regenerates this project and commits it as the acting user. Read it, export it, mirror it;
edit the datasets in the OS.

## Run it

Plain dbt, no OS needed — connect to Trino as yourself with the `local` target:

```sh
export TRINO_HOST=<trino-host> TRINO_PORT=8080 TRINO_USER=<you>
dbt parse --profiles-dir . --target local
dbt build --profiles-dir . --target local --select <model>+
```

The default `trino` target is the one the OS runs: a service user (`TRINO_USER`) impersonating
`OS_PRINCIPAL`, which has no default so a run without a principal fails. Trino→OPA governs either
identity exactly as the OS UI does. `profiles.yml` reads only environment variables; no credential
lives in this repository.

## Layout

- `models/sources.yml` — Bronze landings and federated tables dbt reads but never writes
- `models/silver/`, `models/gold/` — promoted (domain) layers; `models/personal/<uid>/` — personal lane
- `models/**/schema.yml` — descriptions and the quality rules as tests
- `tests/generic/` — the `range` and `not_blank` tests the OS rules compile to
- `macros/os_maintenance.sql` — weekly Iceberg `optimize` + `expire_snapshots`, run by Dagster per schema
- `os/schedules.yml` — sync schedules (cron, UTC, principal) for the Dagster code location
- `os/external.yml` — sources dbt cannot model (Kafka offsets, API batch); Dagster assets
- `models/semantic/<model>.yml` — the `semantic_models:` + `metrics:` of promoted datasets
  (a personal dataset's sit in `models/personal/<uid>/semantic/`; promotion moves the file)
- `models/os/os_time_spine_day.sql` — the daily time spine (a view over `sequence(...)`)

## Models

- `models/gold/gold_orders.sql` — pass-through, schema `sales`
- `models/personal/bea/gold_draft_signups.sql` — pass-through, schema `personal_bea`
- `models/silver/silver_orders.sql` — pass-through, schema `sales`

## Metrics (dbt semantic layer)

This project targets **one** semantic spec version: `dbt-semantic-interfaces 0.7.5`
(= dbt-core 1.9.11), what the OS's Dagster image runs (`dbt-core==1.9.11`). The time spine uses the dbt >= 1.9
`time_spine` model property, never the legacy `metricflow_time_spine` name.

Query them with MetricFlow from a clone:

```sh
mf query --metrics <metric> --group-by metric_time__month
```

- `aov` (ratio) — OS metric `ds_orders1.aov`, in `models/semantic/sales_orders.yml`
- `customers` (simple) — OS metric `ds_orders1.customers`, in `models/semantic/sales_orders.yml`
- `orders` (simple) — OS metric `ds_orders1.orders`, in `models/semantic/sales_orders.yml`
- `revenue` (simple) — OS metric `ds_orders1.revenue`, in `models/semantic/sales_orders.yml`
- `revenue_eu` (simple) — OS metric `ds_orders1.revenue_eu`, in `models/semantic/sales_orders.yml`
- `revenue_per_customer` (derived) — OS metric `ds_orders1.revenue_per_customer`, in `models/semantic/sales_orders.yml`
- `revenue_rt` (cumulative) — OS metric `ds_orders1.revenue_rt`, in `models/semantic/sales_orders.yml`
- `revenue_t7d` (cumulative) — OS metric `ds_orders1.revenue_t7d`, in `models/semantic/sales_orders.yml`
- `sales_draft_signups_revenue` (simple) — OS metric `ds_draft001.revenue`, in `models/personal/bea/semantic/sales_draft_signups.yml`

### Not emitted

These OS metrics have no faithful form in this spec version, so nothing was written for them:

- `revenue_next7` on OS dataset `ds_orders1` — a leading window has no dbt metric form (dbt cumulative metrics look backwards only)

## Run it without the OS

```sh
dbt parse                                   # validates semantic.yml against the project's metrics
mf query --saved-query <name> --csv out.csv  # MetricFlow (once the project runs it)
vl-convert vl2png -i dashboards/personal/b6e1557a1ed3/my-draft/panels/<panel>.vl.json -o panel.png  # data inlined from out.csv
```

# The OS layer of this dashboard: identity, audience, layout. dbt and Vega-Lite never read it;
# delete it and `dbt parse` + `vl-convert` still work (artifact contract 11, AT-f).
apiVersion: os.sovereign/v1
kind: DashboardLayer
metadata:
  id: dash_sales_overview
  name: Sales Overview
  domain: sales
  owner: 1574ad62d48a
  tier: domain
  folder: /
spec:
  view: sales__Orders
  filters:
    - member: sales__Orders.region
      operator: equals
      values:
        - eu
  panels:
    - id: p_revenue
      name: Revenue
      savedQuery: sales_overview_revenue
      chart: panels/p_revenue.vl.json
    - id: p_revenue-by-region
      name: Revenue by region
      savedQuery: sales_overview_revenue_by_region
      chart: panels/p_revenue-by-region.vl.json
      gridPos:
        x: 0
        "y": 0
        w: 6
        h: 2
    - id: p_orders-and-revenue-by-month
      name: Orders and revenue by month
      savedQuery: sales_overview_orders_and_revenue_by_month
      chart: panels/p_orders-and-revenue-by-month.vl.json
    - id: p_customers-by-region
      name: Customers by region
      savedQuery: sales_overview_customers_by_region
      chart: panels/p_customers-by-region.vl.json
    - id: p_region-table
      name: Region table
      savedQuery: sales_overview_region_table
      chart: panels/p_region-table.vl.json
dashboards/sales-overview/semantic.yml:
# dbt saved queries (one per panel) and the dbt exposure for this dashboard. Generated by
# Sovereign OS; `dbt parse` validates it. Identity lives only in `meta`.
version: 2
saved_queries:
  - name: sales_overview_revenue
    label: Revenue
    description: Panel “Revenue” of the dashboard “Sales Overview”.
    query_params:
      metrics:
        - revenue
    config:
      meta:
        os_dashboard: dash_sales_overview
        os_panel: p_revenue
  - name: sales_overview_revenue_by_region
    label: Revenue by region
    description: Panel “Revenue by region” of the dashboard “Sales Overview”.
    query_params:
      metrics:
        - revenue
      group_by:
        - Dimension('orders__region')
      where:
        - "{{ Dimension('orders__region') }} IN ('eu', 'us')"
    config:
      meta:
        os_dashboard: dash_sales_overview
        os_panel: p_revenue-by-region
  - name: sales_overview_orders_and_revenue_by_month
    label: Orders and revenue by month
    description: Panel “Orders and revenue by month” of the dashboard “Sales Overview”.
    query_params:
      metrics:
        - orders
        - revenue
      group_by:
        - TimeDimension('orders__order_date', 'month')
    config:
      meta:
        os_dashboard: dash_sales_overview
        os_panel: p_orders-and-revenue-by-month
  - name: sales_overview_customers_by_region
    label: Customers by region
    description: Panel “Customers by region” of the dashboard “Sales Overview”.
    query_params:
      metrics:
        - customers
      group_by:
        - Dimension('orders__region')
    config:
      meta:
        os_dashboard: dash_sales_overview
        os_panel: p_customers-by-region
  - name: sales_overview_region_table
    label: Region table
    description: Panel “Region table” of the dashboard “Sales Overview”.
    query_params:
      metrics:
        - revenue
        - aov
      group_by:
        - Dimension('orders__region')
    config:
      meta:
        os_dashboard: dash_sales_overview
        os_panel: p_region-table
exposures:
  - name: sales_overview
    label: Sales Overview
    type: dashboard
    description: Sovereign OS dashboard “Sales Overview”. Each panel is a saved query above; its chart is panels/<panel>.vl.json (Vega-Lite v5).
    owner:
      name: 1574ad62d48a
    depends_on:
      - metric('aov')
      - metric('customers')
      - metric('orders')
      - metric('revenue')
    meta:
      os_dashboard: dash_sales_overview

    measures:

        agg: count_distinct
        expr: customer_id

        description: Net revenue booked.
        expr: net_amount
        label: Revenue
      - name: revenue_eu
        agg: sum
        expr: net_amount
      - name: revenue_rt
        agg: sum
        expr: net_amount

        expr: net_amount
